invariants.rationale: Write client is generally required to perform operations; passing null would not be valid for upsertion/commit routines.
An instant time identifier should always be present for any metadata commit operation.
A list of prepared record inputs should never be null; empty if no records are needed.
The file group ids to update need to be provided, if the operation supports selective updates.
The type of preppedRecordInputs must be a List; required for expected interface behavior.
